final: SELECT store_id, AVG(total_amount) AS avg_total_amount, AVG(record_count) AS avg_record_count FROM (SELECT p.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id WHERE p.amount > 4.99 GROUP BY p.rental_id, i.store_id) AS step1 GROUP BY store_id
